verdict.rationale: Metorial documents per-event observability: teams can review traces, sessions, tool calls, auth events and failures. An Agents area shows which clients connected and what they did, and activity logs are kept per environment, which covers users and errors at the log or inspection level. Hosted custom servers also get monitoring. However, nothing shows aggregated usage analytics such as call-volume metrics or dashboards, and there is no cost reporting. Missing for 10: aggregated call-volume analytics/dashboards, cost tracking, per-server/tool usage breakdowns for published servers, independent corroboration.
